# neostella receives SOC 2 certification.

by

Neostella

Apr 15, 2025

![](https://neostella.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/AdobeStock_313059336-scaled.jpeg)

Neostella has officially achieved SOC 2 Type II certification—demonstrating our ongoing commitment to data security, operational excellence, and earning client trust through industry-leading standards.

We are proud to announce that Neostella has successfully completed our System and Organization Controls (SOC) 2 Type II audit, reinforcing our commitment to the highest standards in data security, privacy, and operational integrity.

#### an industry standard in information security

SOC 2 is one of the most widely recognized and respected benchmarks for information security, developed by the American Institute of CPAs (AICPA). This independent audit provides verification that our internal controls and systems are designed to securely manage customer data and protect the interests of our clients and partners.

To complete our audit, we partnered with [Johanson Group](https://www.johansonllp.com/), a trusted firm that reviewed our internal controls across a range of critical areas—including policies and procedures, data security, firewall configurations, logical access, backup systems, change management, disaster recovery, and incident response protocols.

#### going beyond compliance

Achieving SOC 2 compliance is the result of a coordinated, company-wide effort. But we didn’t stop at meeting the minimum requirements. With the support of Johanson Group, Neostella has integrated ongoing compliance monitoring across our infrastructure, ensuring we uphold SOC 2 standards 24/7/365—not just during the audit period.

This certification is one milestone in our broader, evolving security program. We know that our customers rely on us for more than software and services—they rely on our integrity. That’s why we’re committed to ongoing investment in security, including annual SOC 2 audits and continuous improvements to our policies and practices.

We appreciate the trust our customers place in us—and we’ll continue working to earn it, every day.

Questions? Visit [trust.neostella.com](https://trust.neostella.com/) or reach out anytime through [a contact form](https://www.neostella.com/about/contact-us/).
